capabilities.name: flat-fee
capabilities.description: A FLAT charge's fee/penalty is its flat amount, carried in full, with no percentage arithmetic.
capabilities.evidence: T40/T46 captures FC-01, FC-02, FC-06, FC-07, FC-08, T46-CH-02, T46-CH-07: feeChargesDue/penaltyChargesDue equal the requested flat amount.

capabilities.name: percent-fee
capabilities.description: A PERCENT_OF_AMOUNT / PERCENT_OF_DISBURSEMENT charge's fee is PercentageOf(base, percentage) rounded HALF_UP to the currency's minor units, then capped.
capabilities.evidence: T40/T46 captures FC-03, FC-09, T46-CH-06: feeChargesDue equals the exact product (14814.00, 6000.00) and the HALF_UP-rounding case (460.56).

capabilities.name: percent-amount-interest-instalment-fee
capabilities.description: A PERCENT_OF_AMOUNT_AND_INTEREST (calculation type 3) charge with time_type 8 INSTALMENT_FEE has base = the period's principal due PLUS the period's interest due, and fee = PercentageOf(base, percentage) rounded HALF_UP to the currency's minor units, with no min/max cap.
capabilities.evidence: Tier D charges-installment-fee-mnt captures TD-CHG-loan-6-pct-amount-interest-p1/p6: 1% of (16.41 + 0.59) = 0.17 and 1% of (16.94 + 0.10) = 0.1704 -> 0.17; a principal-only port answers 0.16 on p1. TD-CHG-loan-3-pct-amount-p2 is the type-2 control where interest is NOT added.

capabilities.name: penalty-charge
capabilities.description: A charge with is_penalty true is carried and its fee computed identically to a fee; the flag alone does not change arithmetic.
capabilities.evidence: T40/T46 captures FC-06, FC-08, T46-CH-07: penaltyChargesDue is non-zero and equals the flat amount.

capabilities.name: request-governs
capabilities.description: The request supplies the money value (flat amount or percentage); the persisted m_charge.amount is ignored for money.
capabilities.evidence: T46 captures T46-CH-02, T46-CH-06, T46-CH-07: request and definition disagree and the OBSERVED value is always the request's.

seams.name: charge-evaluate
seams.description: POST /loans?command=calculateLoanSchedule (Path B): the running Fineract server's charge arithmetic, observed via its response rows.

note: Charges parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the charge-evaluate seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is inadmissible (default-deny). The five graded capabilities are exactly the dimensions the captures observed: the flat fee amount, the percentage-of-amount fee (and its HALF_UP rounding), the percent-of-amount-and-interest INSTALMENT fee (base = the period's principal plus its interest), the penalty flag carrying the same arithmetic, and the request governing the money value over the persisted definition. PERCENT_OF_INTEREST remains outside the graded domain: the Go charges slice cannot reconstruct its daily-compounded base from a period's principal and interest, so no fee vector may require it.
